sentence: The same literature lists strategic obstacles: AI can be myopic and hard for managers to steer, and, built on explicit knowledge, it resembles a general-purpose technology
passage: [Kemp (2024), p. 618] "Despite this promise, a growing body of research has highlighted that AI may present substantial strategic obstacles. AI may be myopic (Balasubramanian, Ye, & Xu, 2022), incapable of perceiving interdependencies within a firm (Raisch & Krakowski, 2021), and recalcitrant to managerial control (Murray, Rhymer, & Sirmon, 2021)." / "In addition, AI is a form of explicit knowledge (Broussard, 2018; Shrestha, He, Puranam, & von Krogh, 2021), and resembles a general-purpose technology (Teece, 2018)."

gemini.note: The sentence accurately and faithfully paraphrases the claims in the cited passage, properly capturing the listed strategic obstacles and the characterization of AI.
